title: Best Claude AI Video Generator Tools (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.tagline: MCP connector fronting 30 plus video models, clip generation only
tools.claudeConnection: First-party hosted MCP connector, plus an official CLI
tools.modelSupport: 40+ models per the official CLI README

quickstart.label: Install the official CLI, authenticate, and generate:
quickstart.code:
npm install -g @higgsfield/cli
higgsfield auth login
higgsfield generate create nano_banana_2 --prompt "a quiet beach at sunrise" --wait

quickstart.label: For Claude itself, add the connector URL in Settings → Connectors:

tools.name: Runway
tools.tagline: first-party hosted MCP server and a documented API
tools.claudeConnection: First-party MCP server, run locally from Runway's own repo
tools.modelSupport: Runway's own model family plus third-party models, queryable at runtime via runway_listModels
tools.note: Checked 2026-08-31: Runway's MCP server is published as source in its own repo and is installed by cloning and building it, not from a hosted endpoint or an npm package.

quickstart.label: The MCP server is not published to npm — clone and build it, then install it as a Claude Desktop unpacked extension or point your MCP config at `build/index.js`. Needs a Runway developer API key with billing set up.
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/runwayml/runway-api-mcp-server
cd runway-api-mcp-server
npm install
npm run build

quickstart.label: The official SDKs cover the same API without MCP:
quickstart.code:
npm install @runwayml/sdk   # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-node
pip install runwayml         # https://github.com/runwayml/sdk-python

tools.name: Replicate
tools.tagline: API-first model host, community MCP servers, no editor
tools.claudeConnection: Community MCP servers only — no first-party server
tools.modelSupport: Thousands of community and commercial models behind one API

quickstart.label: Official clients:
quickstart.code:
pip install replicate     # https://github.com/replicate/replicate-python
npm install replicate     # https://github.com/replicate/replicate-javascript

quickstart.label: MCP access is community-maintained, so pick a server deliberately and pin it. There is no Replicate-published MCP server to install.

tools.name: Luma
tools.tagline: Dream Machine models with an API and agent tooling
tools.claudeConnection: Community MCP servers only — no first-party server
tools.modelSupport: Luma's own Dream Machine video and image models

quickstart.label: Official Dream Machine SDKs:
quickstart.code:
pip install lumaai        # https://github.com/lumalabs/lumaai-python
npm install lumaai        # https://github.com/lumalabs/lumaai-node

tools.name: OrkasVideoStudio
tools.tagline: local-first composition and editing toolkit for coding agents
tools.claudeConnection: First-party local MCP server and installable agent skills
tools.modelSupport: Provider-agnostic optional generation; zero-key composition and editing
tools.note: The npm packages are not published yet; install from source. Optional generation uses your own provider keys.

quickstart.label: Install from source and verify the local media toolchain:
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio.git
cd Orkas-VideoStudio
pnpm install && pnpm build
node packages/cli/dist/index.js doctor
